name: PHANTOM GRID: Manhunt Protocol
subcategory: AR citywide manhunt / live action game
description: Phantom Grid is a structured AR manhunt game operating across designated M88 districts: one player per match is designated the Phantom and given a 90-minute head start to disappear into the city's physical and digital infrastructure, while a team of six Hunters uses AR overlays, city sensor data (licensed from the municipal grid), and BCI coordination to track them down. The Phantom wins by surviving; Hunters win by achieving neural-lock — getting close enough for a BCI handshake confirmation. The game is genuinely terrifying and genuinely exhilarating in equal measure.
story_hooks: A Phantom Grid match goes wrong when the 'Phantom' — a decorated veteran player — goes genuinely missing mid-game; the Hunters don't know if it's brilliant strategy or something else.
Someone is running unofficial Phantom Grid matches in Tier 1 with real stakes — the 'Hunters' are debt collectors, and the Phantoms don't know the game they signed up for.
A player discovers that the municipal sensor data Phantom Grid licenses includes feeds that shouldn't be commercially available — and the data is being retained long after matches end.
